description: Sweep a zone's nameservers: the same names and types asked at a sample of its authoritative addresses, reporting disagreements, lame or silent servers, serial and TTL differences, the CAA in effect, and each _acme-challenge TXT or CNAME. Not for a public resolver's answer: dig. Asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, named on each answer. Every question not asked is listed with why, and an answer past 22,000 bytes is trimmed with counts, the whole sweep at its api: URL. names are labels under domain (@ for domain itself), 16 at most, and types 8 at most.

domain.description: The zone or name to sweep, e.g. example.com. Also as "name"; a URL is read as its host.

names.description: Labels under domain, "@" for domain itself. Default: @, www, _dmarc, _acme-challenge

types.description: Record types. Default: SOA, NS, A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CAA

name: sweep_domain

api.description: The /api GET that asks it again, as a new reading

certReadiness.description: Per name: the CAA set that governs it and its _acme-challenge TXT and CNAME

holdback.description: The sample: addresses known, addresses asked, and each address not asked with why

notPrinted.description: Counts trimmed to fit, all at api

receipts.description: One per DNS read: what, of whom, from where, when, rcode, flags, EDE, ms, answer

results.description: One row per name and type: flags, answers, not asked

servers.description: Each nameserver address: name, address, family

title: Sweep a zone's nameservers
